decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the three contiguous Bartow County tax parcels owned by Switch Ltd on Bates Road (C106-0001-014 at 82 Bates Rd, 0075-1032-002 at 90 Bates Rd and 0075-1032-003 at 96 Bates Rd), the property of the Georgia EPD-listed "The Keep 2 Campus" at 78 Bates Rd SE, Cartersville, as the campus locator.
layer: Bartow County GIS (www.bartowgis.org) AGOServices/BartowLand FeatureServer layer 2 "Tax Parcels"; native CRS Web Mercator (EPSG:3857)
excluded: Five other Switch Ltd parcels (Old Goodie Mountain Rd, Lead Mountain Rd and Crystal Mountain Rd, about 1.2 to 3.4 km south-east) do not touch the Bates Road group and are not attributed to the EPD-listed campus.

computed.method: Planar centroid of the shapely union of the three WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygons (duplicate attribute rows of 0075-1032-003 share one geometry); cross-checked against the centroid of the native EPSG:3857 union transformed with pyproj (planar centroids in different projections differ slightly); geodesic areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: Georgia EPD Air Protection Branch public advisory PA0826-4 (comments due 25 September 2026) lists Facility Name "The Keep 2 Campus", Application No. 30289, Facility Address 78 Bates Rd SE, Cartersville, 30120, Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services, to construct and operate additional main generators.

The Bartow County tax parcel layer returns Switch Ltd as owner of three contiguous parcels on Bates Road (82, 90 and 96 Bates Rd, 139.8 geodesic acres); the county address-point layer has no point for 78 Bates Rd; its points for 90, 92 and 96 Bates Rd lie inside these parcels, and the nearest lower numbers (52 and 57 Bates Rd) lie about 60 to 120 m outside them at the west end of the road.

Bartow County's data-center policy statement (3 August 2026) refers to "Switch, in Cartersville but still a part of the County tax digest" and says Switch, while in the City, is served by the Bartow County Water System; parcel C106-0001-014 lies in the Cartersville tax district.
Switch's Atlanta page (version of 12 October 2026) features an "ATLANTA KEEP 2.0 Construction Flyover Video".
unresolved: The exact parcel carrying the EPD address 78 Bates Rd SE is not published; the point locates the contiguous Switch-owned Bates Road holding as a whole, not a building.
Press figures of a 126-acre Cartersville site are not used; the three parcels total 139.8 geodesic acres.
